about.title: About
about.description: This platform simplifies internship management between students, employers, teachers and the college's internship manager.
about.managerSummary: Oversees the whole process: validates CVs and internship offers, links students with companies, assigns teachers, starts contract signing and tracks progress through reports.
about.employerSummary: Posts internship offers, reviews interested students, invites them to interviews, signs hiring documents and evaluates the intern at the end of the internship.
about.studentSummary: Chooses a discipline, uploads a CV for approval, browses and applies to offers, records interview dates and reports when an internship has been found.
about.teacherSummary: Follows and supports students during the internship through weekly calls, visits the company and fills in the internship site evaluation form.
